Introduction to Tulsi Leaf Powder

Tulsi, or holy basil, is an aromatic herb traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations and herbal teas. As a tulsi leaf powder exporter, Tradenest Naturals supplies dried holy basil leaf powder to tea, food and cosmetic brands overseas. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers in India. Our processing aims to keep the natural aroma and green colour of the leaf. Food and wellness brands expect clean handling, so we follow food hygiene practices under our FSSAI registration. Every lot is checked before packing. If you need a dependable bulk tulsi leaf powder supplier india, we offer consistent lots and supply that can grow with you.

Sourcing and Processing

Our workflow starts with careful raw material selection. First, we clean the leaves to remove stems and foreign matter. Next, we dehydrate them under controlled conditions. This gentle drying helps protect the aroma and keep the green colour. After drying, the leaves are milled and sieved to an even 80-100 mesh. We keep milling heat low so the aroma stays intact. As a tulsi leaf powder supplier, we never add colours, preservatives or fillers.

Quality Assurance and Technical Specifications

Each lot is checked for colour, aroma, texture and moisture, which is kept at or below 8%. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. The powder has a warm, peppery herbal flavour. We pack in food-grade materials that keep out moisture during transit. The shelf life is 24 months in cool, dry storage. Whether you want pure holy basil powder wholesale or private label packs, we can match your technical needs.

Applications and Industry Uses

Tulsi powder is used in many sectors. Beverage brands use it in herbal teas and instant infusions. Supplement companies fill it into capsules. Cosmetic brands add it to face masks and herbal skin care. Food makers also use it in seasoning and functional food blends. Because of this range, buyers often compare tulsi powder bulk price quotes across suppliers. We support businesses of all sizes, with an MOQ of 5 Kg.

Partner with Tradenest Naturals

A good supply partner keeps your production on schedule. We offer OEM packing and tulsi powder private label packing services. Our team can help with custom packs and labels. As an ayurvedic herb exporter india and IEC registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and clear communication. Contact our sales team to request a quote or sample.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the minimum order quantity for tulsi leaf powder exporter?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger volumes and private label runs are quoted to your packaging needs.

What are the typical specifications of your powder?

Our standard powder is dehydrated, 80-100 mesh, with moisture at or below 8% and no additives.

How do you pack export orders?

We use moisture-resistant, food-grade multi-wall bags, HDPE drums and custom private label packs.
